moments.text: Infrared view looking down on pale, pitted desert ground; a green crosshair rests on a small dark patch. Black redaction boxes line the edges.
A large blurred four-sided shape, orange-brown then dark, rises from the bottom edge right of the crosshair and leaves the top. About 0.4 s.
A thin dark streak enters at the top left and slides down-left, leaving the lower left edge. About 0.25 s: use frame step.

notes: Official description says 00:01-00:05 and 00:08-00:10 have no content; the video shows the static ground scene with crosshair throughout.
